verdict.rationale: Lovable offers programmatic access mainly through its official MCP server, which lets an agent create projects, send messages, inspect code and deploy apps (lovable-docs-37). There is also a link-based 'Build with URL' API (lovable-docs-53), and chat can trigger project actions such as publishing and finding a domain (lovable-docs-56). However, there is no documented general-purpose API and no claim of parity with the UI, and the OpenAPI/Swagger probes all returned 404 (lovable-probe-2). Missing for 10: a documented REST/OpenAPI API, explicit UI-parity coverage (settings, collaboration, credits/billing, domains, security scans, database admin), and independent hands-on corroboration.
